COMMISSION
REAGAN HOUSTON. CHAIRMAN DEWITT C. GREER CHARLES E. SIMONS
STATE DEPARTMENT OF HIGHWAYS AND PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION
P.O. BOX 5051 AUSTIN, TEXAS 78763 May 17, 1976
ENGINEER-DIRECTOR
B L DEBERRY
Proposed Hydroelectric Power Generators Amistad Lake
IN REPLY REFER TO FILE NO D-10M
Mr. J. L. Johnson, P.E.
Acting Chief, Engineering Division
Department of the Army
Fort Worth District, Corps of Engineers
P. O. Box 17300
Fort Worth, Texas 76102
Dear Sir:
With reference to your letter dated 22 April, 1976 requesting information concerning the above proposed project, please be advised of tentative plans to acquire additional right-of-way for an improvement on U.S. Highway 90 from U.S. Highway 277 northwest to Spur 249.
If there are plans to locate transmission lines adjacent to any of our designated highways in the area, we could possibly avoid expensive relocation costs if notified of such plans in advance.
Although we have no immediate plans for highway improvement project in the area other than the one stated above, any of our highway matter may be subject to widening as dictated by future traffic needs. We have no present plans for additional highway facilities to be constructed on new locations in this area. If we can be of further service or supply additional information, please advise.
Sincerely yours
B. L. DeBerry
Engineer-Director
By:
Phillip L. Wilson
State Planning Engineer
